focus.jbig: Oil spikes, CPI tomorrow · scanner boarded just 1 · stand aside into the print
focus.jtag: Records wobble as WTI jumps ~5% on Hormuz doubt; July CPI lands tomorrow AM and locks out GREEN
focus.jnote: The backdrop is still near records — but the risk clock is now ticking loudly. The S&P 500 slipped ~0.06% Monday to ~7,753, pulling back from Friday’s record ~7,758, while the Nasdaq fell ~0.32% to ~26,605 and the Dow eased to ~53,975. The overnight story is oil: Iran hardened its Strait-of-Hormuz reopening conditions, and WTI jumped to ~$84.50 (Brent ~$84), extinguishing near-term deal hopes and re-firing the geopolitical supply premium. That oil move feeds straight into inflation fear right as July CPI prints tomorrow (Wed 8/12, 8:30 AM ET) and PPI Thursday (8/13) — the week’s marquee macro tests. The VIX is still low near ~15.5 but ticking up, and the 10Y sits at ~4.70%.
focus.notdown: Energy is the day’s clearest bid as crude spikes on the Hormuz breakdown — and the scanner did board one energy-adjacent name, CLMT (Calumet), a Type C breakout riding a post-earnings surge to fresh highs. But the entire energy move is a war/supply premium: one credible de-escalation headline and crude gives back several dollars fast. Treat energy strength as a two-sided trade, not a clean Sniper bid, and verify CLMT’s chain before doing anything.
focus.notup: No clean bearish single-name boarded this morning. Fuel-sensitive cyclicals (airlines, transports) are pressured by the crude spike, and long-duration tech is exposed if CPI runs hot on top of the oil move — but selling bear calls into a low-VIX, record-adjacent tape the day before CPI carries squeeze risk on any benign print or de-escalation headline. The disciplined answer is to sell nothing new into the CPI event.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? Composite is 52 (WARM) and P(≥1% gap) is ~34% (a whisker under the 35% trigger) — already elevated. More decisively, CPI prints tomorrow morning inside the next 24h, which under the rules cannot be GREEN and defaults to YELLOW. Stack on the fresh oil supply shock (WTI ~$84.50) and an open-ended Hormuz tail, and the honest stance is: half size, A-grade only, keep DTE short enough to clear CPI/PPI or simply wait for the prints to pass, and validate every chain at 9:35 ET.

setups.read: Calumet (CLMT) is a Type C breakout to fresh highs — it surged ~15% Monday to close ~$45.47, clearing its ~$44.19 all-time closing high and pressing the ~$45.20 52-week high, on breakout-day volume ~2.56x the 50-day average. The move rode a strong Q2 print (reported Aug 7) and a wave of price-target hikes (BofA to $45, others higher). Two honest concerns: (1) it is a same-day breakout still proving itself — and note the underlying catalyst (earnings) is actually days old, so this is more momentum-extension than a fresh break; and (2) the ATM options market was flagged one-sided/unverified (OI ~8,175 but no confirmed two-sided quote), and IV is high (~0.61). Pre-market prints were mixed (~$45.20 after-hours). Only 2 S/R layers behind price (pivot $44.19 −3.1%, sma20 $42.19 −7.4%). Next earnings ~Nov 6, outside DTE.
setups.check_note: Liquidity is the gate — the ATM chain was one-sided/unverified; confirm a tight two-sided spread and OI at 9:35 or SKIP. It’s a same-day break on a days-old catalyst into CPI-eve — quarter-to-half size at most, and keep DTE clear of tomorrow’s CPI.

risks: July CPI · Wed 8/12 8:30 AM ET — the week’s marquee macro print and the direct test of the rate-cut narrative that lifted stocks to records. A hot number stacked on the fresh oil premium is the worst-case macro combo — keep any new spread’s DTE clear of it, or wait for it to pass.

Strait-of-Hormuz breakdown — Iran hardened its reopening conditions, killing near-term deal hopes and sending WTI to ~$84.50. Any further escalation or a tanker incident sends crude (and the whole tape) gapping — the week’s biggest open-ended tail.
Oil & the 10-year — WTI ~$84.50 and Brent ~$84 feed inflation fear right into CPI; the 10Y is ~4.70%. A rate pop on top of the oil move pressures long-duration stocks.
PPI · Thu 8/13 8:30 AM ET — back-to-back with CPI, producer prices plus the oil pass-through compound mid-week index-gap risk. Keep DTE short enough to clear both prints.

Thin/unverified boarded liquidity — the only boarded name (CLMT) carries a one-sided/unverified ATM chain and high IV. Verify a real, tradable two-sided market at 9:35 before selling anything — do not force a fill.
